caption: The drawing depicts a single, wooden chair positioned in the center of the composition. The chair features a rectangular backrest and a flat seat with straight edges. The wood of the chair is dark brown, with variations in shade suggesting the texture and grain of the material. The chair's front legs are turned and rounded, with decorative shapes, while the back legs and supporting structure are simple and squared. Stretchers connect the legs near the base, with two horizontal bars on each side and a crossbar at the back. The background is a solid, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations. A subtle shadow falls beneath the chair, anchoring it to the surface. The artist’s signature, "J. Rothenberg," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Side Chair
